For use of individuals (including directors, partners and trustees)

To: Comfort Home Furnishing Pte Limited trading as Flexible Purchase, 18 Yarawa Road, Nabua, Suva.

1. I consent to Flexible Purchase:

  1. Providing information about me to any credit reporting agency licensed under the Fair Reporting of Credit Act 2016.
  2. Obtaining information about me, typically as a credit report, from a Credit Reporting Agency and using that information in relation to products and services Flexible Purchase may provide to me; another person or entity for which I am a guarantor; or an entity with which I am connected, including as a director, partner or trustee.
  3. Holding, processing and storing that information, including any credit report, and this consent through actual, electronic or virtual data storage.

2. I consent to a Credit Reporting Agency:

  1. Collecting information about me from Flexible Purchase; and
  2. Disclosing information about me, typically as a credit report, to Flexible Purchase.

This consent applies to all credit products and services Flexible Purchase may provide to me or to the other persons or entities referred to above.

I acknowledge that this has been explained to me and that I understand why my consent is being obtained, and that I can access and request correction of information held in a Credit Reporting Agency database by the Agency or Flexible Purchase at any time.
